ハブ内蔵ジャイロの角度です。向きは約−180〜180度で折り返します。距離センサ: Hub motion-sensor angle. Heading wraps near -180/180 degrees. The distance sensor has no gyro.
現在の向きを0度の基準にします。傾きは初期化せず、ドリフトを防止する校正ではあり: Set the current heading to zero. Tilt is unchanged. This is not drift-prevention calibration.
本体を動かさずに使います。3軸の角度変動が0.5度以内で1秒続いたら向きを0にし: Keep the hub still. Reset heading after three-axis angle variation stays within 0.5 degrees for one second. Timeout reports an error. This does not prevent or correct drift while moving.
距離センサーの4つのランプを同じ明るさにします。0％で消灯、100％で最大。測定: Set all four distance-sensor lights to the same brightness. 0% is off; 100% is maximum. These are display lights.
本体の物理X・Y・Z軸まわりの回転速度。フィルター済みの値です。向きの角度とは別: Filtered rotation rate about the physical hub X/Y/Z axes. This differs from heading; resetting heading does not change this value.
本体の物理X・Y・Z軸の加速度。1000mG＝1G。重力を含み、静止中も必ず0に: Filtered acceleration on physical hub X/Y/Z axes. 1000mG = 1G. Includes gravity, so a stationary hub need not read zero.
<h3>距離センサーのランプと本体ジャイロ</h3><p>「表示」の距離センサー:
Distance-sensor lights and hub motion

Set distance-sensor lights to 0–100% in Display. In Sensors, read hub angles, X/Y/Z angular velocity in degrees/second and acceleration in mG (1000mG = 1G, including gravity). Initialization checks angle stability for one second, then resets heading. Keep the hub still; choose a maximum wait of 1.1–30 seconds. This aids startup referencing, not internal calibration or drift prevention. Hardware behavior is unverified.
予定外の停止を検知（5秒直進）: Detect a motor stall (5-second straight drive)
